name: Berettyóújfalu (Hungary)
description: Blue field charged at the centre with the town arms of Berettyóújfalu (a blue shield with a yellow lion and a fish, with a helm, a crest and red, blue and yellow mantling) above the name BERETTYÓÚJFALU in white.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Berettyóújfalu arms with helm, crest and mantling
